UNA POR UNA pero BIEN HECHAS PERFECTAS»): the second of the eleven classes, «El consorcio», a new A0–C2 3D conversation and listening class in a Buenos Aires apartment building, whose A0 level is fully bilingual (conversation, neighbours, choices and listening) and whose A1 level glosses its key words in English, plus one English line for the academies listing. This manifest approves only the exact English support literals listed below (the English half of each { es, en } pair in app/el-consorcio/levels/a0.mjs and a1.mjs and the level and UI pairs of app/el-consorcio, the English who / basic lines of app/el-consorcio/vecinos.mjs, the contextEn / en / qEn / glossary fields of app/escucha-3d/content/consorcio/a0.json and the academies card body in app/academias/page.tsx); existing English copy stays protected.
